task: Resolve checked record-constructor facts to the exact runtime ObjectType by nominal declaration identity.
observation: Fast Debug already had an exact checked nominal declaration ID and TypeContext entry for standalone `State(...)`, but the sole matching ObjectType had an empty `defining_module`. The consumer looked only in `Program::module_identities`, which is empty for standalone sources, so it skipped the object and reported no unique ObjectType. `program_module_identity()` supplies the same canonical standalone module identity used when the TypeContext declaration was created; using it preserves exact declaration-ID comparison and the uniqueness check.
impact: Standalone field controls and source-free imported Payload construction can resolve through the same declaration identity path. Drop, duplicate, and wrong-module ObjectType mutations continue to fail in the production validator.
evidence: e3d884dcc9ef98495b39363f9b47f6764529f03c scratch trace: checked declaration and TypeRef ID were `nominal-template-v1:module-v1:__standalone__@0.0.0::main:type:State`; one candidate ObjectType, empty defining_module, absent module map entry
